programme.title: Tentacle 8
programme.desc: A mysterious computer virus wipes out highly classified personnel files at the NSA, prompting a top secret investigation. Raymond Berry, an NSA operative suspected of crimes against the United States, risks his life to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Susie's Hope
programme.desc: Based on a true story, the inspirational relationship between Donna Lawrence (Emmanuelle Vaguer) a pit bull attack survivor, and Susie (Susie Lawrence), an abused pit bull-mix puppy, as they learn to heal and forgive together.

programme.title: Like Sunday, Like Rain
programme.desc: Surrounded by wealth and living with abundant resources in Manhattan, 12-year-old cello prodigy Reggie, lives a solitary life lacking only frequently absent parents and friends. Estranged from family, having slacker boyfriend troubles, and fired from her waitressing job, sometimes musician 23-year-old Eleanor needs a new place to live and a new job.

programme.title: Watercolor Postcards
programme.desc: A small town girl with a troubled past returns home only to find that both her sister and her hometown are in peril. Only when she falls for a man who similarly has dark days behind him will they muster up the faith and love needed to save the things they hold dear in life.

programme.title: Walt Before Mickey
programme.desc: A young man named Walt Disney had big dreams, and no matter how many obstacles he had to face he never gave up--from his tumultuous childhood, to serving his country, to borrowing money, to the creation of his first iconic animated character Mickey Mouse.

programme.title: Camp Cool Kids
programme.desc: At their summer camp competition games, Spence and his big brother Zach find themselves on opposing teams: its the dweebs against the bullies. Can Spence make new friends, overcome his fears and find faith in himself, stand up to the bullies and win a trophy in the process?

programme.title: The Highest Pass
programme.desc: Part heart-pounding adventure, part spiritual quest, THE HIGHEST PASS, a feature length documentary, premiered in Los Angeles to sold out audiences. The award-winning film shares the journey of seven seekers, including one who has never ridden a motorcycle, who follow a guru with a Vedic death prophecy on a moto journey up to the highest pass of the Indian Himalayas. Over 21 days and up to an elevation of 18,000 feet along a winding road, they never let low oxygen, altitude sickness, river-flooded roads, icy edges, snow and loaded trucks dampen their spirits or, ultimately, their deeper selves.

programme.title: Millionaire Maker
programme.desc: Shawn Meaike's Millionaire Maker is a new series that shows you what you're really worth. Shawn is confident he could pluck anyone - no matter their background or experience - and turn them into a 7-figure earner...IF, they have the right attitude and drive. This series is about Shawn selecting who he will mentor and teach to reach a level of success they never thought possible. Welcome to the toughest job interview of your life. In this episode, Shawn meets the contestants and immediately finds out who's actually willing to fight for the life they want.

programme.title: Millionaire Maker
programme.desc: Shawn only wants folks who are willing to be honest about their struggles because it shows you can be fearless. Everyone deserves a happy life...but he can only help you if you're ready to take a chance on yourself. In this episode, the candidates have to sell themselves. They have to tell Shawn their story because he wants to know how you got stuck...but more importantly, they have to convince him they won’t give up...no matter how hard it is to hang on, or take a leap of faith.

programme.title: Millionaire Maker
programme.desc: If you had a chance to close Shawn, could you get it done? Today's the day we see who has the goods. Each team has one goal. Get the contract signed. Shawn is not going to make it easy, but often your audience isn't the hardest part. Sometimes getting out of your own way is the biggest challenge. Prepare to witness a pitch fest for the ages. You'll see that it doesn't matter what you're selling - a Yacht, a Ferrari, a Private Jet...or a Potato - if you don't connect with Shawn, you have no chance.

programme.title: Millionaire Maker
programme.desc: This is it. A winner will be chosen. The decision is FINAL...But we still have a crowd of candidates that each think they will be the one. Now comes a test of mental toughness. It's all come down to these final moments. Who can convince Shawn that they won't give up when things get...painful. What would you endure for a chance at greatness?...Watch the season finale of Shawn Meaike's Millionaire Maker.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Birth Of A Guitar Part 1

This is Rick’s first attempt at a guitar, and as such, I am not presenting this as a “how-to”. Instead, this is just one man’s experience as he works his butt off making a beautiful guitar for his wife. I think you are really going to enjoy it. A special thanks to Rick for allowing me to “Whisperize” his content!"

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: SketchUp Basics - Trunk Lid Part 2
programme.desc: In part two of our three-part series, Aaron shows us how to make the frame parts for the top of our lid. Now these videos do assume that you’ve opened the program and have a little familiarity with the tools.

programme.desc: Build a miniature trebuchet and sling some crap around!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Scary Mystery Dust and Kitchen Remodel

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Lessons Learned from Past Projects
programme.desc: Ever wish you could fast forward 5 years and see how your projects are holding up? That would certainly be useful information as it would let you know what worked, and what didn’t. So in this episode, I pull out a number of old projects and examine them closely for damage, flaws and evidence of wood movement.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Mortising Jigs & Through Mortises
programme.desc: There are lots of methods available for making mortises. One of the most versatile tools for mortising is the hand-held router. You can do a lot with the manufacturer's edge guide but you can do even more if you know how to design and construct simple jigs or guides.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Interview with Kaleo Kala

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Veneered Pantry Cabinet
programme.desc: A veneered pantry cabinet featuring continuous grain.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Exploded Sofa Table
programme.desc: My mom recently requested I build her a sofa table since everything she found was either too big or too small. Her size requires were 30″ High, 14″ Deep, and 46″ Wide. As long as I hit those dimensions she didn't care what the table looked like. I took this as a fun opportunity to design on the fly, experimenting with some 'new to me' ideas and tapping into my creative side.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Moving Out of the Dream Shop
programme.desc: It seems that I'm gaining something of a reputation as a "frequent shop-mover." It's probably well-deserved since I've moved my shop four times already. If you're playing along with the Where's The Wood Whisperer home game, here's the score so far.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Kids Kitchen Step Stool
programme.desc: The Kids Kitchen Step Stool is an asset to any family with kids! One of Nicole's favorite things to do with our son is cook. So I set out to design a kids step-stool that includes features like safety elements, height adjustability, custom-sizing for kitchen countertops, and a nice wide platform. The end result is the Kids Kitchen Step Stool with some Arts & Crafts flair.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Installing LED Shop Lighting
programme.desc: We're working exclusively with American Green Lights who designed and supplied our lighting solution. The fixtures are PerformaLUX SL Series in both single strip 24 W models and 5-strip 60 W models. These units can save 50-60% compared to traditional fluorescent lights, have a lifetime of 120,000 hours, and feature a CRI of 92-95 (for color accuracy).

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shellac Under Polyurethane
programme.desc: I decided to do a little experiment for myself. I wanted to see if I could find any evidence of a weakened bond between polyurethane and waxed shellac, when the shellac is used in a typical manner as a sealer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Low Entertainment Center Part 4
programme.desc: An important aspect of building furniture that many new woodworkers overlook is the importance of finishing before the project is completely glued together. That’s the primary focus of this part of the series.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Hand Tool Basics with Kaleo Kala
programme.desc: A quick review of some basic hand tool techniques with my buddy Kaleo Kala.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Artist's Easel
programme.desc: This year's Woodworkers Fighting Cancer build is an awesome little artist's easel. This is a simple project that can be easily done in a weekend!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Castle Bookcase
programme.desc: The Castle Bookcase is not only great for storage but also serves as a creative play center for kids of all ages. It features four shelves, a functional drawbridge, battlements, and windows. The entire thing is made from two sheets of plywood and is constructed using glue and screws. For additional strength you can cut dados for the shelves as demonstrated in the video.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 5 Tips for Laying Out Project Parts
programme.desc: Whenever I lay out my project parts in rough lumber, I find that there are 5 things that I always try to keep in mind.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Why Are We Destroying a Perfectly Good Table?!
programme.desc: Why would be destroy a perfectly good table? To make it even better, of course!!!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Sculpted End Table Part 3
programme.desc: I start by gluing the leg blanks to the aprons. I then cut the rough shape out on the bandsaw. And finally, I use the template and a flush trim bit in the router table to get the exact shape we’re after. I also spend a good deal of time discussing the dangers involved with this routing operation.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Bosch Glide Vs Festool Kapex
programme.desc: I don't consider myself a very good reviewer. I have no desire to do a feature by feature and spec for spec rundown commonly found in our favorite woodworking magazines. Instead, all I can offer is one man's opinion and a completely biased personal impression based on my needs and the type of work I do. So here it is!

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Graciela llorando le pide disculpas a Atanasio y le dice que no lo volverá a molestar ni a él ni a su esposa. Atanasio también con los ojos enrojecidos | le pide disculpas a ella Bienvenida le dice unas cuentas cosas a Solymar por lo de Graciela Gisela comienza a hablarle a Atanasio de la gente que está en el restaurante. Atanasio obstinado le dice que se vayan y ella acepta. Segundo le dice a ROKUro que le gusta Carolina pero que ella nunca aceptará a un taxista.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Doroteo confiesa a María José que está deprimido por La Nena. Santiago defiende ferozmente a Luis Fernando y le provoca para que se decida a recuperar a un verdadero amigo. Yesenia se desmaya al escuchar la propuesta de matrimonio de Marco Aurelio.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska manipula a Ricardo mientras Moisés busca la verdad sobre su padre. Manuela defiende a Misael ante Hortensia y sospecha estar embarazada. Tras un fuerte enfrentamiento entre Graciela y Celia por Ricardo, se revela el embarazo de esta última, lo que desata las intrigas de Katiuska. Finalmente, Moisés llega a casa de Celia ignorando que es su madre, mientras Benjamín lo busca desesperadamente tras su ausencia del liceo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto cuenta a Marisela en la clínica todo sobre Consuelo y la hija perdida, incitándola a vengarse. Marisela enfrenta a Adolfo delante de Junior y Andreína, jurándolo públicamente. Alejandro entrega a Rosa los 500 mil bolívares del marcapasos. Adolfo exige a Alejandro cumplir con Rosalía. Eustoquio se queda frío: el cheque del comprador de dólares es rechazado por el banco. Erasto recibe una citación de la PTJ. Junior consuela a Rosa mientras Alejandro lucha por mantener su promesa de casarse con Rosalía.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca le hace una visita a Trinidad para dejarle la ropa de Irene y, de paso, humillarla. La mujer termina echándola de la casa prácticamente a patadas. Irene le comenta a Virginia que Felipe le ofreció ser el padre de su hijo por nacer y Virginia cuestiona la voluntad de su hermana de negarle la paternidad a Leonardo. Julio acude a casa de su abuela, Jimena, para interrogarla sobre su identidad. La mujer le da de largas y no contesta su pregunta.Juan Pablo va al motel donde Carlos Ernesto, Tony y Maribel esperan la hora de viajar al Caribe y le lleva los documentos. Por casualidad, Juan Pablo sube al auto de Carlos Ernesto y el mismo estalla en mil pedazos. Adolfo se congratula de lo bien que ha salido su plan.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro deja que Sol le tome una prueba de ADN para comprobar si es el padre de Esperanza, agregando además la condición de que ella haga esas pruebas en un laboratorio sin que él no sepa, para así no tener chance de adulterar los resultados. Luego, Sol y Alejandro se reencuentran, y aunque Alejandro insiste en no ser el padre de Esperanza, Sol le confirma que nunca ha estado con otro hombre que no sea él. Él la besa a la fuerza, pero llega Alejandrito y deben separarse.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa y Alejandro pasan la tarde íntima en un hotel; Rosalía y Junior descubren su ausencia furiosos. Adolfo contrata un detective con Consuelo para hallar a su hija. Eustoquio golpea brutalmente a José Luis por orden de Erasto. Maricela acepta unirse a Alcohólicos Anónimos con Alberto. Adolfo va a la tienda y le exige a Consuelo despedir a Rosa para proteger a Rosalía; Consuelo se niega. Consuelo e Isaías se topan con Maricela en una sesión y descubren que ella es la mujer con la que Isaías iba cuando se accidentó.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: José Luis llega golpeado a la residencia y acusa a Erasto. Blanca, al oírlo, expulsa a Natalia al confirmarla como amante de Erasto. Arminda y Eustoquio aterrorizan a Erasto disfrazándose de Benedicto para enloquecerlo. Isaías confiesa en voz alta su alcoholismo en la sesión. Salvador confiesa a Adolfo que siempre supo de la hija perdida. Alejandro se desahoga con Gualberto, quien le aconseja dejar a Rosalía. Junior incita a Rosalía y ella jura hacer algo que impedirá que Alejandro la deje, gestando lo que será su gran mentira.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Maricela pide a Alberto que le consiga un certificado de embarazo falso. Erasto humilla a Natalia llevándola a su propia casa frente a Arminda. Blanca llega a casa de Erasto a confrontarlo, acusándolo de querer matarla para casarse con Natalia. Alejandro intenta romper con Rosalía, pero ella le muestra el certificado de embarazo falso, paralizando su decisión. Adolfo promete a Consuelo seguir buscando a su hija. Rosa cuenta a Carmen el pasado de Consuelo y su hija perdida; Carmen se desmaya conmocionada al oír la historia que toca demasiado de cerca su propia herida secreta.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carmen es hospitalizada y René advierte que necesita un marcapasos costosísimo. José Luis muestra a Alejandro recortes de prensa que prueban que Erasto asesinó a Carlos. Adolfo discute con Rosalía al saber del embarazo y exige a Alejandro que cumpla con ella. Erasto visita a Consuelo reprochándole haber revelado a Adolfo lo de la hija. Marisela jura vengarse al saber por Erasto el pasado entre Consuelo y Adolfo. Junior va a la residencia para informar a Rosa que Rosalía está embarazada de Alejandro, destrozando sus ilusiones.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En el bufete se abogados Finita discute con Armando al reprocharle este sus intenciones de relacionarse con Briggite Armando se defiende del ataque de su antigua amante al recordarle su matrimonio y defender su derecho de olvidarla con otra mujer que este dispuesta a convertirse en su esposa. En el centro comercial Solimar le fija su posición a Botero al sentirse irrespetada por los piropos de un hombre casado | Botero sintiéndose frustrado por el rechazo de Solimar culpa a la gordura de Finita.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri sintiéndose víctima de los efectos del alcohol le confiesa a Juan Diego sus sentimientos por el ganándose así el interés del muchacho quien se muestra sorprendido debido a su inocente confesión. En el centro comercial Solimar se reúne con Wilker informando a este sobre su preocupación por Yubiri desde que su mejor amiga se aparto de ella al saberla relacionada sentimentalmente. Olegario intenta disimular su antipatía por Mauricio.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Bienvenida conversa con Yubiri al saberla afectada por la relación existente entre Solimar y Wilker descubriendo en su hija un sentimiento de amor capaz de intervenir en la relación de su mejor amiga con el muchacho | Bienvenida aconseja a Yubiri para que esta no se deje enloquecer por su sentimiento y acepte acercarse nuevamente a su amistad con Solimar al relatarle la cruel verdad sobre la transitoriedad de la presencia de los hombres en la vida de las mujeres.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Solimar insiste en hablar con Yubiri para hacer a su amiga participe de su incomodidad tras haberse sentido una víctima de sus ofensas | Yubiri se disculpa ante Solimar al reconocer su falta al verse impedida a darle a su amiga una explicación en vista de la torpeza de sus celos por saberla involucrada sentimentalmente con Wilker | Solimar intenta aclarar su situación con Yubiri al mostrarse sincera ante ella al recordarle el juego limpio que la llevo a comprometerse en una relación de noviazgo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela intenta salvar su matrimonio con Ricardo mientras lidia con su rechazo hacia Elizabeth y las intrigas de Katiuska. Celia descubre que está embarazada y busca retener a Ricardo, quien impide que Manuela la enfrente. Entretanto, Moisés busca la verdad sobre su padre, y Marcelo enfrenta tensiones familiares tras su separación de Graciela. En medio de conflictos y secretos, Misael muestra interés por Manuela, mientras Katiuska sigue manipulando para separar a la pareja principal.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo enfrenta el acoso de Celia, quien le oculta su embarazo, mientras Manuela investiga a Misael. Moisés busca a su padre con apoyo de Elizabeth. Entre tensiones familiares y secretos, Ricardo teme perder a Manuela tras la llegada de Graciela. Benjamín sabotea a Rebeca y Verónica intenta seducir a Marcelo sin éxito. La Nonna se enfrenta a Katiuska para proteger la relación de su nieto, mientras los conflictos por el pasado y las herencias amenazan la estabilidad de todos.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: La Nonna se enfrenta a Katiuska por intentar separar a Ricardo y Manuela. Mientras Verónica seduce a Marcelo, Celia oculta su pasado y Elizabeth revela su nuevo embarazo, lo que amenaza el matrimonio de su padre. Katiuska sigue intrigando contra la pareja, manipulando pruebas y sembrando dudas sobre la amistad de Manuela con Misael, quien confiesa su amor por ella. Ricardo descubre que Misael y Donatella están casados, mientras Graciela busca soluciones para la infertilidad de Manuela.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia confirma su embarazo de Ricardo, desatando conflictos con Manuela y Juan Marcos. Katiuska manipula a Manuela y destruye pruebas legales, mientras Graciela oculta su infertilidad y sabotea romances ajenos. Brigitte escapa de rehabilitación e intenta seducir al padre Alejandro. Entre secretos sobre el pasado de sus padres e intrigas por herencias, los personajes enfrentan traiciones y decisiones desesperadas que ponen a prueba sus relaciones.

programme.title: Blue Ridge
programme.desc: El ex Boina Verde, Justin Wise, cambia su vida de peligro por una placa de sheriff en un pueblo tranquilo en el corazón de las montañas Blue Ridge. Ahora más cerca de su ex esposa e hija, está listo para establecerse y abrazar una vida sin caos. Pero los problemas tienen una manera de seguirlo. Justo cuando comienza a adaptarse a la vida sencilla, un asesinato en la comunidad pone nerviosos a los residentes y reaviva una larga disputa entre dos de las familias más poderosas. A medida que Justin y sus ayudantes trabajan en el caso, se da cuenta de que hay más en su nuevo hogar de lo que parece. Los secretos se revelan y los motivos emergen, lo que lleva a Justin a una carrera contra el tiempo para resolver el caso antes de que la gente del pueblo tome la ley en sus propias manos.

programme.title: Jerry Springer

programme.title: Jerry Springer

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, la compra de SIM Cards prepago sin cédula facilita delitos como extorsión y robo de celulares. Miller Steven Falla fue asesinado por su celular, mostrando la gravedad del problema. Expertos y autoridades piden registro obligatorio para reducir estos crímenes.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En el hospital El Salvador de Ubaté, muertes de bebés por negligencia médica se acumulan entre 2022 y 2023. Padres denuncian diagnósticos erróneos y falta de insumos. La Gerente, ya señalada en un caso anterior, es el blanco de las acusaciones.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Accidentes de tractomulas en Colombia, como el de San Gil en 2017 y Subia en 2021, son cada vez más comunes y peligrosos. Fallas mecánicas y errores humanos son las principales causas. Las víctimas y sus familias buscan respuestas y soluciones para evitar más tragedias.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Gladys y César descubren inconsistencias en sus casas prefabricadas en Medellín y Chinauta. Alba recibe amenazas tras desistir del contrato. Rocio y Sebastián investigan con cámara oculta. Constructora Ksas y Dinami Casa enfrentan denuncias por incumplimientos y estafas. Las víctimas luchan por justicia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En las sombras de las cárceles colombianas, las visitas conyugales se convierten en escenarios de horror. Reclusos peligrosos, aprovechando fallas en la seguridad, transforman momentos íntimos en tragedias.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, varios casos de muertes neonatales han revelado graves negligencias médicas. Las familias afectadas buscan justicia. La falta de leyes que protejan a las madres ha llevado a impulsar una legislación para prevenir la tragedia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Desde 2023 Colombia vive una ola de violencia en sus carreteras. Trágicos asesinatos y los crecientes asaltos y homicidios en el transporte intermunicipal, la inseguridad en las vías es un reflejo de la indiferencia gubernamental.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Carmen fue engañada por un hombre que conoció en línea después de querer una vida mejor para su hijo.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, Bryan Steven Rivera, un niño de 7 años, desapareció en la zona cafetera de Colombia; una testigo relató que un hombre lo atrajo con dulces. La investigación llevó a un retrato hablado de "El Peruano", identificado como Carlos Alberto Gómez Loaiza, con antecedentes por abuso sexual violento. Reconocido por testigos, fue detenido en Pereira para responder por la desaparición del menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Soacha, Doris Góngora y su hija de 8 años fueron halladas asesinadas en su vivienda. Evidencia de sangre, huellas y registros telefónicos llevaron a los investigadores hasta Jorge Antonio Trujillo, sobrino de Doris. A pesar de negar los cargos, las pruebas forenses lo vincularon directamente con el doble crimen. Fue condenado a 60 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y hurto calificado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Luisa Fernanda Garcés, de 13 años, desapareció en Villamaría, Caldas, en agosto de 2014, un día después de que su familia denunciara un abuso sexual sufrido meses antes. Su cuerpo fue hallado en el río Cauca. Gabriel Jaime Marulanda, el agresor identificado, fue capturado en 2015 y condenado a 46 años por homicidio agravado y 9 años más por actos sexuales con menor de edad.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Deibis Mildred y Adolfo González formaron una familia y un negocio exitoso de confecciones en Riohacha. En 2008, Adolfo fue asesinado en su casa, un crimen inicialmente sin resolver. Tres años después, las sospechas recayeron sobre Deibis Mildred, señalada de planear el homicidio junto a un amante para cobrar un seguro de vida. Fue condenada a 40 años de cárcel como coautora del asesinato.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 28 de febrero de 2016, Helen Gordillo (9) fue asesinada en Villeta. Un mes después, Israel Rodríguez, vecino de la niña, fue capturado. El crimen habría sido por venganza, tras una discusión con la abuela de Helen por una deuda.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2012, en La Virginia, Risaralda, Angie Xiomara, una niña de 9 años, desapareció mientras estaba al cuidado de su tío, Víctor Alfonso Cardona. Días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en un cañaduzal. Testigos y evidencias llevaron a la captura de Cardona, quien confesó el crimen. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y acceso carnal violento contra su sobrina.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Silene Acuña, embarazada, fue hallada muerta bajo el piso de su casa en Mosquera en abril de 2010. Su pareja, Luis Giovanni Mosquera, confesó el crimen tras huir y fue condenado a 21 años. Su hijo, testigo clave, reveló el asesinato en entrevista.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Barbara demanda al club de striptease de Emilio por 30.000 dólares, alegando negligencia y angustia emocional. Ella afirma haber sufrido un latigazo cervical por la actuación de Jackson y una silla que se derrumbó. Emilio niega su responsabilidad, citando la seguridad y el consumo de alcohol de Bárbara.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Jennifer Lozada, de 46 años, demanda a su esposo y a su amante por enajenación de afecto.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Michael Brown demanda a Víctor Hernández, propietario de la tienda de tatuajes "Savage Skin", por 50.000 dólares, alegando que Víctor alteró maliciosamente el diseño de su tatuaje debido a un rencor por salir con la ex de Víctor, provocando un tatuaje vergonzoso. Víctor dice que es un malentendido.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. Annie se siente traicionada y retira a Olivia de la fiesta nupcial. Olivia se defiende, dice que mejoró la boda.

programme.title: Los Informantes

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Fernando Araújo, exministro e ingeniero, fue secuestrado por las FARC en 2000 y mantenido cautivo durante 6 años en los Montes de María, soportando condiciones extremas. Perdió su matrimonio, pero recuperó su vida: dos meses después, el presidente Uribe lo nombró Ministro de Relaciones Exteriores.

programme.title: Maury

Ezequiel insists on talking to her about romance and feelings and the young woman reminds him that this is not what they agreed upon. Marcelina visits Ezequiel in the hospital and he takes the opportunity to threaten her if she tries to hurt Camila again.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila is alert to the obvious hypocrisy of Fausto and Patricia, however, she manages to get out of the incessant questions by sticking to her strategy of bringing peace to the two families. programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila approaches him trying to calm him down and the commando takes advantage of the situation to subdue the young man. Camila runs to take refuge in Max's arms. programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto with double intentions invites Camila to dinner at his house so that she can get to know her new family. Ezequiel insists on talking to her about romance and feelings and the young woman reminds him that this is not what they agreed upon. Marcelina visits Ezequiel in the hospital and he takes the opportunity to threaten her if she tries to hurt Camila again.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila is alert to the obvious hypocrisy of Fausto and Patricia, however, she manages to get out of the incessant questions by sticking to her strategy of bringing peace to the two families. Inconvenient, with Roger and Gregorio, she tells Ezequiel who promises her that he will be able to take revenge for everything they have done to her.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Roger takes Camila to a building under construction, alone, under duress he makes her talk to Ezequiel, who threatens Roger to kill him if he harms Camila. Roger expresses all the hatred how he murdered his brother Marcos. Max and Torrealba arrive and find Roger out of control, with Camila as hostage.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila approaches him trying to calm him down and the commando takes advantage of the situation to subdue the young man. Camila runs to take refuge in Max's arms. Later, they inform Ezequiel that Camila is safe. When the inspector interrogates her, she, following instructions, does not press charges and this infuriates Max, but it is part of his conciliatory plan.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Amelia and Fausto, on their wedding day. Camila arrives, dazzling, provoking the admiration of some and the contempt of others. She is sincere with Father Tiziano about what she comes to fulfill for the priest is tremendously strong, because he does not know in her the girl she helped raise. Ezequiel stirs up hatred and gives instructions that must be followed.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max comes to get Camila from the police, she thanks him for the gesture but refuses to reveal her plans to him. Mother Isabel finds the three women together and suspects them of planning to kill Camila. Beginning her plan, Camila convinces Max and Marcelina to put the past behind them.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila visits Marcelina. Before her and Max tells her that it was Rosa, her mother, who made her change her mind, and they will not press charges against her. Max asks her to marry him but she surprises him by telling him that she no longer loves him. Max proposes to Astrid a formal relationship to forget about Camila forever.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: As part of her plan, Camila has changed, both physically and in her attitude. This is how she presents herself to everyone. Max and Astrid continue their romance; however, he keeps remembering Camila and wants to know all the truths that Astrid and Marcelina are hiding.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Marina vive una vida ordinaria: trabaja como cajera en un banco y tiene una relación con su colega. Quiere aventura, peligro y emoción, pero cada día es como otro, y no le ocurre nada interesante... Hasta que unos enmascarados toman el banco, y Marina, entre los demás empleados, es tomada como rehén. Se enamora del cabecilla, aunque no pueda ver su rostro bajo la máscara.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Galia enfrenta la enfermedad terminal de su hijo Pavlik, quien necesita un costoso tratamiento en EE.UU. Mientras tanto, su distracción permite que una clienta robe en la tienda donde trabaja, lo que la pone en la mira de la policía. Por otro lado, Misha y Kolia inician su negocio de ropa ilegal, pero Kolia pierde las primeras ganancias.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha descubre cuánto necesita para el tratamiento de su hijo y decide expandir su negocio ilegal. Junto con Kolia, establece un taller de costura clandestino, pero un vecino intenta sabotearlos. Mientras avanzan en su venta de trajes de baño, la policía empieza a sospechar de sus actividades.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha y Kolia consiguen más tela con ayuda de Grigori, pero necesitan evitar levantar sospechas. Kolia obtiene una firma clave seduciendo a una secretaria. Mientras su negocio crece, un arresto inesperado pone en peligro toda la operación.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Mientras Kolia distrae a Ígor, Misha ayuda a Gena a escapar. Sin embargo, Galia es arrestada por fraude debido a Raisa. Misha intenta negociar su liberación sin éxito. Paralelamente, un trato con Ashot fracasa cuando la policía interviene, y Misha es secuestrado por un criminal llamado Boxeador.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha se enfrenta a Pan, un poderoso criminal, y negocia su vida y la de Galia a cambio de una alianza. Kolia intenta reunir dinero para ayudarlo, pero fracasa. Ahora, bajo el control de Pan, deben aumentar su producción de ropa, mientras Raisa confiesa sus crímenes y libera a Galia de los cargos.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha convence a Vasili de seguir colaborando tras revelarle la enfermedad de Pavlik. Galia regresa y sospecha que Misha la engaña. Mientras tanto, Pan ordena robar un tren con telas en lugar de comprarlas. Misha rechaza el robo y encuentra una alternativa con paracaídas de seda obsoletos.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Igor descubre que Gena es el proveedor de productos ilegales y lo entrega a la policía. Misha y Kolia pagan 30 mil para liberarlo, pero Gena es atropellado por Boxeador. Al mismo tiempo, Misha y Sima solicitan una visa para Israel, causando revuelo en su entorno, lo que lo obliga a renunciar a su trabajo.

Here, the walls are bursting with energy and talent, as students learn how to let their true colors shine with Grit, Love, Action and Moxie (yep, we call it GLAM). The series takes us inside this one-of-a-kind school through the eyes of eight first-year students, teamed for their very first exam: a full-stop, make-or-break high-tech fashion runway show, with the added stakes of being kicked out if they can’t perform. These girls will start out strangers, but as they’re forced to come together or fail, they’ll have to find the best in each other, and themselves to make their visions come to life, and eventually, BFFs.

programme.desc: In Newfoundland, the rhythm of life is dictated by survival. It's a rugged existence, but the DIRT crew discovered it breeds a wild, abundant kinship. Their guide, chef Jeremy Charles, turned Newfoundland's raw ingredients into world-class cuisine. He took them out to stock up his way—with fishing poles, shotguns, and foraging baskets. programme.title: Huckberry Homes
programme.sub-title: Huckberry Homes - "An Exclusive Look Inside The Explorers Club's Members-Only Clubhouse | HB Homes Special Edition
programme.desc: "In this special edition episode of Huckberry Homes, we travel to New York to get a rare look inside The Explorers Club headquarters. For the last 120 years, The Explorers Club has been the exclusive epicenter where legendary explorers come together to share some of the most incredible adventure stories ever told. From Roald Amundsen's 1911 voyage to the South Pole to Sir Edmund Hillary's ascent to the summit of Mount Everest to astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin's history-changing 1969 expedition to the moon, the halls of this institution have echoed with tales of daring discovery and unparalleled human achievement. That's why we're beyond stoked to kick off our Huckberry x The Explorers Club partnership—featuring the Land, Sea, and Space Collection from an exclusive Whiskey Peaks collab and a badass grand prize. Tune in now to watch a tour so exclusive, it's almost like being inducted into the club itself (minus the secret handshake). "

programme.title: Mike Speenberg
programme.desc: Mike Speenberg has been a professional touring Stand-up comedian for 20 years. He's performed on 5 different continents, entertained everyone from Hall of Fame Athletes to US Diplomats, shared the stage with everyone from Robin Williams to Bill Burr, and been featured on everything from CNN to the AMERICAN FORCES RADIO NETWORK.

programme.title: Andrew Rivers
programme.desc: Andrew's very personal and fun storytelling comedy, combined with his exemplary work ethic has earned him high praise from some of the best comedians in the business. Andrew is a featured writer, actor, and comedian on the TV show “UpLate NW.” Andrew has been featured on NBC, FOX, and the Bob & Tom Radio Show and is a regular opening act for Christopher Titus. Andrew was also featured on the popular Buzzfeed web series “Truth or Drink“, has performed in over 35 states and his new podcast called “Don't Quit Your Night Job” was featured in the Seattle Times.

programme.title: Collin Moulton
programme.desc: Collin is one of the most fun, personable, and sought after headliners today. He has had his own stand-up special on SHOWTIME, he's been on NICKELODEON, and was recently featured on LAST CALL WITH CARSON DALY. Touring for over 15 years Collin has gained an ease and enjoyment on stage that makes every show worth watching.America knows and loves him. His familiarity and energy engages and relieves the audience before he even speaks. His electric storytelling style makes you care about every topic he explores. Collin's comedy is the release needed from our every day lives. Come needing to laugh tonight, leave wanting to laugh forever!Collin Moulton

programme.title: Costaki Economopoulos
programme.desc: For 20 years Costaki has been living his dream as a full-time stand up comic. He has written jokes for Bette Midler, Jay Leno, MTV, and BET. You may have seen him on Showtime or heard him on Sirius, but you probably know him best from his regular appearances on the nationally syndicated Bob & Tom Radio Show.

programme.title: Tim Young
programme.desc: Tim headlines clubs all over North America, has performed on over 500 college campuses as well as comedy festivals in New York, Montreal, and Seattle, and he's a fixture in the New York City club scene. He was a finalist on NBCs Last Comic Standing, has appeared on Comedy Centrals Premium Blend, Tough Crowd, and Shorties, and you may have seen him as a commentator on VH1, MTV, TLC and the E! Channel.

programme.title: Brad Upton
programme.desc: Brad Upton first stepped on stage in September of 1984 and he's never looked back. This ex-grade school teacher is now in his 30th year of comedy and is nearing 6000 lifetime performances. He is a past winner of the Las Vegas Comedy Festival and appeared recently at Caesar's Palace as part of the HBO Comedy Festival. He has spent the last eight years as the opening act for the legendary Johnny Mathis and did multiple shows all over the country with the late, great Joan Rivers. He has also been seen in concert with The Smothers Brothers, Smokey Robinson, Kenny Rogers, Dolly Parton, Lewis Black, George Jones, Glen Campbell, Pam Tillis and many others. Coast to coast all over North America isn't the only place Brad performs. In 2014 Brad headlined in Singapore, Hong Kong, The MGM in Macau and did eight nights in Israel as part of the Comedy for Koby benefit. His new CD entitled, "Brad Uptonogood" is heard regularly on Sirius Satellite Radio and is available online wherever music is sold. He also just released his first DVD entitled, "Brad Upton, Live from the 509".

programme.title: Don Friesen
programme.desc: Husband. Idiot. Dad. His kids think he's fun. His wife thinks he's an idiot. Audiences think he's hilarious! Don is a modern suburban dad just trying to raise his kids and get through the day with a bit of money in the bank and a scrap of dignity intact. With a unique style that can best be described as frenetic and engaging, Don captures the irony of parenting, marriage and everyday absurdities through characters, voices, parodies and some of the best written routines around. He's a wanna-be geek who constantly upgrades to the latest technology, but can never get it to work, leading to signature bits about tech support, Idiots Guides, texting and passwords. Friesen has recently taken his smart, savvy, and highly-caffeinated comedy to the stage at the Alex Theatre in Glendale, CA, for the taping of his new Showtime one-hour special titled "Ask Your Mom." In his first nationally released concert special, Don delivers a winning hour of clever, true-to-life "he's talking about my family up there" comedy that manages to be adult-smart yet family-friendly.

programme.title: Andy Woodhull
programme.desc: Andy recently appeared on Conan on TBS. Around that same time, his half-hour special premiered on Comedy Central. He was the first comedian to make his network television debut on “The Tonight Show starring Jimmy Fallon”. He also appeared on Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen, and Gotham Comedy Live on AXS. He had also appeared on Comedy Central's “Live at Gotham” in 2009.

programme.title: Cory Michaelis
programme.desc: A teacher by day and comic by night, Cory Michaelis keeps his act edgy enough to keep the audience from feeling like they're in his 10th grade History class. He cleverly tells short stories and jokes that try to get audiences to think but are silly and absurd as well. Cory is a regular in all of the clubs in the Pacific Northwest and has headlined clubs, colleges, casinos, and weird bars all over the country. He didn't win the 2013 World Series of Comedy (semi-finals), the 2012 Seattle International Comedy Competition (SICC), or the 2014 Tacoma Comedy Contest (2nd) but he took another crack at the SICC and made the 2014 finals.

programme.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled
programme.desc: Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers' Tower. Ultron's ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they've stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it's on! It's a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man's suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron's control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN!The Avengers prepare for a party with a surprise guest when Ultron crashes the preparations by using mind control on Iron Man. While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron's plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off!

This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: Sun Ra
programme.sub-title: Sun Ra Arkestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1985, pianist and space-faring jazz icon Sun Ra and his Arkestra crash-landed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Featuring saxophonists Marshall Allen, John Gilmore and Danny Ray Thompson, clarinetist Eloe Omoe, flautist James Jackson, trombonist Tyrone Hill and a cavalcade of other costumed talents, Sun Ra puts on a truly out-of-this-world concert.

programme.title: Gerry Mulligan, Dave Glenn, Harold Danko & Ed Neumeister
programme.sub-title: Gerry Mulligan Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American saxophonist Gerry Mulligan gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Mulligan was one of the leading arrangers of the cool jazz era, who worked with Miles Davis, Stan Kenton and Claude Thornhill in the 1950s and 1960s. Mulligan's early pianoless 1950s quartet with trumpeter Chet Baker is still regarded as one of the finest groups in cool jazz. Born in New York in 1927, Mulligan spent his life composing, arranging and playing jazz until his death on January 20, 1996.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth' trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: Raul Midón
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón's performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind' was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: Fats Domino
programme.sub-title: Fats Domino - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. American singer and pianist Fats Domino gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1980. Domino was one of the pioneers of rock and roll music, selling more than 65 million records and having 11 top hits between 1955 and 1960.

programme.title: Woody Herman
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Ryan Porter & Kamasi Washington
programme.sub-title: Ryan Porter & The West Coast Get Down - BIRD
programme.desc: Los Angeles-born saxophonist Kamasi Washington and trombonist Ryan Porter co-founded West Coast Get Down – a musical collective fusing jazz and funk with hip-hop. It is partly because of this collective that jazz saw a resurgence in Los Angeles, subtly eclipsing the long-established jazz mecca of the world, New York City. The two musicians join forces and take the vibes of Los Angeles to jazz club BIRD in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Stephanie Childress, Alina Ibragimova & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress conducts the London Symphony Orchestra and Sibelius and Mendelssohn provide the soundtrack for this unique concert with a distinctly Northern European flavor, live from London's LSO St Luke's. The evening begins with Jean Sibelius's En Saga, a symphonic poem that, like its composer, has become a defining figure of Finnish national musical identity. On the other side of the Baltic, it took Mendelssohn six years to complete his famed Violin Concerto—and it was well worth the wait, as violin virtuoso Alina Ibragimova's powerhouse rendition will demonstrate! The concert ends in style with two short works from Finland: Lumière et pesanteur by the fabulous Kaija Saariaho—ranked the world's greatest living composer by BBC Music Magazine—and another work by the endlessly inventive Sibelius, the spirited and episodic Cassazione.

programme.title: Andrea Bacchetti
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In the current recital, Bacchetti performs J. S. Bach's celebrated Goldberg Variations, BWV 988. Completed in 1741, the work is named after German harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg, who might have been the first to have performed the work. Bach's masterpiece consists of an aria and a set of thirty variations. Rather than writing variations on the aria's melody, Bach used the accompanying bass line as his starting point. This performance was recorded at Theater Carlo Felice in Genoa, Italy, on April 13, 2015.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan, Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris, Choeur de l'Opéra national de Paris & Ricarda Merbeth
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven's final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. He conducts the Orchestre and Choeurs de l'Opéra national de Paris and four vocal soloists Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Daniela Sindram (mezzosoprano), Robert Dean Smith (tenor), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Beethoven composed his last Symphony when his hearing had all but gone, between 1822 and 1824. Symphony No. 9 is the longest and most ambitious of Beethoven's symphonies. Most striking is the piece's finale movement, which includes a choir and four vocal soloists singing a setting of Friedrich Schiller's poem ‘An die Freude' (Ode to Joy). This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky & Vadim Rudenko
programme.sub-title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A Ravel's La Valse (arr. for two pianos) Arensky's Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15 and Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance' from Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture' from Nikolai Kapustin's Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Jihye Kim, Johan Karlström & Christine Nonbo Andersen
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program. Under the direction of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, Highlander, and The Chronicles of Narnia. Featured soloists in this concert are Danish soprano Christine Nonbo Andersen, Korean percussionist Jihye Kim, Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Swedish bass Johan Karlström, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2019.

programme.title: Johnny Cash
programme.desc: Johnny Cash was one of the most influential figures in American music in the post war period. He managed to combine elements of folk, rock 'n' roll and country, which together with his distinctive voice and guitar style, created an instantly recognisable sound. 1994 was to prove to be Cash's only appearance at the Montreux Festival. The "Man In Black" had just released his acclaimed American Recordings album and his European tour took in Montreux on July 5. This classic concert features a number of tracks from his new album coupled with favourites from across his career including Folsom Prison Blues, I Walk The Line, Ghost Riders In The Sky, Orange Blossom Special and San Quentin. An added bonus is the guest appearance of his wife June Carter Cash on two tracks. Caught at one of the high points of his distinguished career this is truly Johnny Cash at his best.

programme.title: Ray Charles, Bo Diddley, James Brown & B.B. King
programme.desc: This amazing concert brings together some of the true pioneers of rock n roll music including B.B. King, Bo Diddley, Jerry Lee Lewis, Little Richard, James Brown, Fats Domino and. Recorded in Italy in 1989 it features these legendary artists in performance of their best loved tracks such as Papas Got A Brand New Bag, Bo Diddley, Great Balls Of Fire, Whole Lotta Shakin Goin On and Blueberry Hill.At the end of the concert all the performers come together for all-star jam that leaves the audience hollering for more.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Rush's 'Time Machine' shows in 2010/11 were one of the most anticipated tours ever. Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centrepiece of the concerts. The shows also featured favourite tracks from across their lengthy career and two recent ones. As ever the concerts were a visual feast and sounded great with the band playing at the top of their form.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.desc: Kylie Bucknell, a troubled young woman, attempts to steal the safe from an ATM but the police capture her. Due to her history of recidivism, she is sentenced to house arrest for eight months under the care of her mother, Miriam. Kylie does not get along with either her mother or her stepfather, Graeme. A security contractor, Amos, explains that Kylie's ankle monitor will alert the police if she ever leaves the premises of her mother's house. Kylie is further frustrated when Miriam claims the house is haunted. Amos takes Miriam's suggestion of a haunting seriously and promises to return with ghost-hunting equipment. After a series of unexplained experiences, Kylie comes to believe there may truly be a ghost in the house. Graeme reveals that their home was once a halfway house and the site of a horrific murder. They discover evidence of the crime, including an orthodontic retainer. Amos attempts to break into her neighbor's house next but the neighbor says that he is not the killer. He tells the story of a young savant, Eugene, whom he adopted. Eugene is an expert at mechanics and electronics and disappeared a year before the killing. Kylie discovers Eugene's secret hallways in their house. She and Amos converge at the police station, and Amos corroborates her wild stories of a serial killer living in the hidden passageways. Once Dennis reveals that he wears a retainer, Kylie becomes suspicious of him. When she confronts him he attempts to kill Miriam and Kylie. Kylie and Miriam flee into the secret tunnels, where they encounter Eugene. Realizing that their paranormal activity has been Eugene all this time, they realize that he is friendly. Dennis stabs Eugene, knocks out Kylie, and begins to strangle Miriam. Eugene wakes Kylie and hands her a weapon, which she uses to stab Dennis. Eugene throws a switch, and high voltage explodes Dennis' head. Months later, all have recovered and Eugene has seemingly become an accepted member of the household.

programme.desc: In this inaugural "Michael's 101: Tomato Edition," Michael Symon, Carla Hall, and guest Christina Miros dive into tomato fundamentals. Michael teaches salt-tasting technique using sliced tomatoes to calibrate palate preferences, demonstrates blanching and peeling methods, and covers roasting approaches from quick to overnight. The episode explores heirloom varieties, storage tips, and growing mistakes like overwatering. The team blind tastes five store-bought tomato sauces to identify which work best as finished products versus cooking ingredients, ultimately preferring San Marzano-based options for their balance and versatility.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: A special compilation episode looking back at the best Chew It or Screw It moments from the past six months, featuring some of the show's most memorable guests playing along as the hosts ask them to weigh in on food, lifestyle, and totally random preferences. Segments include: Danielle Sepsy (the Scone Queen) forced to choose between scones and muffins—predictably choosing scones—plus her takes on stuffing vs. mashed potatoes and canned vs. homemade cranberry sauce; Liz Symon (Michael's wife) on orange wine, foofy cocktails, lazy sundaes, the New York Times Spelling Bee app (Queen Bee 99% of the time), stinky cheese, and the truth about cuddling with Michael; Marysol Castro on Citi Field hot dogs, pineapple on pizza (a hard Bronx no), and celebrity cameos at sporting events (the exception being Bad Bunny); Amanda Freitag and the crew on going out to eat on Valentine's Day (screw it—you get the worst service and cooks who rarely go out); Devyn Simone on cooking for someone on a first date (surprisingly chew it, as long as boundaries are established) and not texting the next day after getting lucky; Esther Choi on breakfast for dinner, ketchup on eggs (a unanimous screw it from the entire panel); Scott Conant on sending food back at a restaurant (screw it—you're an adult, figure it out), family style with strangers (chew it), and splitting the check 12 ways; Damaris Phillips on cornbread with sugar, Miracle Whip with bologna, and the boat-ride romance that made her appreciate Miracle Whip on a sandwich; Maneet Chauhan on spicy desserts, taking the last bite when sharing a dish (chew it if you're single and looking for a partner), and eating off someone else's plate; Mika Leon on the five-second rule, helicopter parenting, staying up 24 hours to cook (chew it—she did 32-plus hours on a cooking competition), and going to the club (hard pass, she's tired); and Chef Jackie Bula on air fryers (screw it—just fry), and reality cooking competitions (screw it—it's less about the food than the show). Audience engagement prompts woven throughout invite viewers to comment on their own chew-it-or-screw-it takes.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Chewed Up Compilation #2: BLOOPERS showcases the funniest and most unexpected moments from season four. Clinton accidentally consumes a THC-infused beverage before reading fan mail, Michael passionately debates whether air fryers are just convection ovens and defends wood cutting boards, and Carla reveals her unconventional Christmas card habits. The episode features heated discussions about bagel varieties, seed oils, Instagram fitness culture, and holiday movie preferences. The climax occurs during a butter cookie demonstration when a frozen egg yolk refuses to incorporate and a pastry bag catastrophically fails on camera, turning an otherwise polished cooking segment into comedic chaos.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: The Chewed Up crew sets up poolside at the W Hotel South Beach for a breezy St. Patrick's Day episode that swaps corned beef for Cuban grilled shrimp. Michael Symon, whose Cleveland neighborhood is deeply Irish, admits he's been celebrating St. Patrick's Day with his best friend Jimmy for decades, and this year Jimmy joins them in Miami. Michael's Grilled Shrimp Mojo is a tribute to the Cuban flavors of Miami: shrimp marinated in lime zest, lime juice, chili flakes, and olive oil, then grilled and finished with a vibrant mojo sauce blended from sour orange, onion, a whole head of garlic, cilantro, parsley, and oregano. The key tip: cook shrimp until they look like commas, not O'sóthe moment they curl completely is the moment they're overdone. Clinton reflects on his seven years living in Miami and the city's culinary depth, from Cuban staples to modern restaurants like Yardbird. Carla raises her fear of sharks; Clinton counters with his inexplicable terror of birds getting caught in his hair. Michael confesses he bought a bathing suit specifically to go to the beach, put it on, saw himself in the mirror, and decided to spend the afternoon in bed instead.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Just in time for National Ravioli Day, acclaimed chef and Chopped judge Scott Conant joins the trio at the W South Beach to make his delicate ricotta gnocchiótechnically gnudióalongside his signature Martone Street jarred tomato sauce. Michael has been close friends with Scott for 15 years, and Clinton admits he was genuinely nervous before meeting the notoriously stern Chopped judge, quickly discovering he's warm and funny in person. Scott explains that Martone Street is named for his grandparents' home in Waterbury, Connecticut, where Sunday dinners taught him that conversation over food is one of life's greatest gifts. The gnocchi dough combines fresh ricotta, basil, breadcrumbs, flour, egg, and Parmesan, shaped into small dumplings and cooked until they float. Scott builds a stabilized butter sauce using pasta water and cornstarch as an emulsifieróa trick that keeps it smooth for hours. Finished with Martone Street sauce and broccoli rabe, the result is stunning in its simplicity. His philosophy runs throughout: spaghetti aglio e olio, done correctly, is one of the most complex and satisfying dishes imaginable. Scott becomes emotional talking about watching his 16-year-old daughter drive for the first time and the joy of steak cook-offs with his girls at home.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Two-time Tournament of Champions winner and Chopped veteran Maneet Chauhan arrives at the W South Beach as a true Queen of Flavor, demonstrating her Indian Spiced Ceviche, a dish that applies Indian culinary logic to coastal Latin technique. Fresh fish is cured in lime juice in the traditional ceviche manner, then transformed with coconut milk to soften the heat and balance the citrus, and finished with a tarka: the Indian technique of blooming whole spices in searing hot coconut oil and pouring it directly over the dish at the last second. The result is layered, bright, and unexpected. Maneet explains that she grew up in a small town in India and learned to cook by exploring her neighbors' kitchens, each representing a different regional tradition. She recounts a pivotal story from Peru, where she made potato pancakes alongside a local woman without sharing a single word of common languageóconnected entirely through food and gesture. That philosophy runs through her Nashville restaurant, which introduces diners to bold Indian flavors through fusion dishes like hot chicken korma and chicken tikka salad poutine. She draws a parallel between the tarka and the French beurre blancóboth finishing techniques that transform a dish in the final seconds of cooking. Michael, Clinton, and Carla taste the ceviche with genuine surprise and awe.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: As the Chewed Up crew wraps up their week at the W South Beach, Miami-born chef Mika Leon brings the most authentically local dish of the entire trip: Pan Con Lechon, the slow-roasted Cuban pork sandwich that anchors Noche Buena, Cuban Christmas Eve. Mika woke up at 4 AM to start the pork shoulderómarinated overnight in a mojo sauce built on sour orange juice, lime juice, orange juice, and 50 cloves of garlic from her grandfather's recipe. After six hours at 350 degrees, the pork is shredded and crisped with additional mojo in a hot pan, then piled high on a special Cuban rollósweeter and fattier than regular bread, made with lard throughout. Mika shares her journey from dabbling in TV production (she quit after a week) to opening a food truck selling $5 Pan Con Lechons at 3 AM to Miami club-goers, which grew into a full restaurant and now a cookbook. Carla notes that the best cooks often learn from family before any formal training, and this dish proves it. The group discusses Miami's cultural identityómore its own country than a Florida cityódefined by Spanglish, its own traffic logic, and immigrant food traditions passed down for generations. Clinton finally admits that despite a full week at the W, none of them ever made it into the pool.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London break down the costume design of Sydney Pollack's 1982 comedy Tootsie, designed by Ruth Morley. The hosts discuss how the film's wardrobe serves the plot of struggling actor Michael Dorsey reinventing himself as the soap opera star Dorothy Michaels, analyzing specific outfits worn by the main cast including Dustin Hoffman, Jessica Lange, and Teri Garr. Key segments include examining Garr's chic party look, the strategic use of high necklines and flowing skirts to conceal Hoffman's masculine features, a standout costume montage featuring magazine covers and an iconic red sequined dress, and Jessica Lange's effortlessly chic final scene outfit. The hosts debate costume choices, offer styling advice, and ultimately praise the montage as essential to the film's fashion appeal.

programme.title: Mt. Joy: Live from Red Rocks Night 1
programme.desc: Mt. Joy kicks off the first of two sold-out nights at the legendary Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Morrison, Colorado. Captured live by Veeps, the set blends fan-favorite hits and new unreleased tracks in a high-energy performance that showcases the band’s signature mix of soaring vocals and indie-rock warmth. Highlights include “Lemon Tree,” “Highway Queen,” and a special collaboration on “Lake Missoula” featuring Richy Mitch & The Coal Miners. A powerful opening night that sets the tone for a weekend of unforgettable music under the stars.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Actor and writer O’Shea Jackson Jr. joins Joel Madden for an insightful conversation about Hollywood’s misconceptions, family legacy, and creative purpose. Jackson discusses balancing fame with authenticity, lessons from his upbringing, the importance of privacy in the digital age, and how writing became a core outlet for his creativity. From his early experiences being homeschooled on film sets to his philosophies on life and parenthood, this episode reveals the thoughtful and grounded side of the Den of Thieves 2 star.

programme.title: GHOST: Rite Here Rite Now
programme.desc: Filmed during the GRAMMY-winning rock band’s sold-out RE-IMPERATOUR finale at the Kia Forum in Los Angeles, Rite Here Rite Now fuses blistering live performance with a haunting cinematic narrative. Led by Papa Emeritus IV and his nameless ghouls, Ghost delivers theatrical rock anthems, eerie storytelling, and striking visuals in this immersive concert film. Combining songs like “Spillways,” “Call Me Little Sunshine,” and “Watcher in the Sky” with a supernatural storyline, the film captures the band’s balance of grandeur, satire, and devotion to spectacle. Includes an exclusive Q&A with Tobias Forge, Alex Ross Perry, and Jim Parsons from the London premiere.
